event: Nimue reaches for the third answer: the cold reach toward the System's own readout.
The Tower makes the reflex permanent; she feels a lens seat behind her eye, cold and exact.
Her sight turns the pole into a list: weight, balance, the bent place near the cuff.
The System: ANCHOR SET, THE SEER. Open Eye fills Essence Slot 1.
Anchoring lean applied, +2 ATT and +1 INS: ATT 12, INS 11, HP 100, Focus 60, Strike 20.

changes.note: The Open Eye anchor's lean adds 2 ATT
The Open Eye anchor's lean adds 1 INS

event: The numbers settle like a diagnosis: a way of seeing, not strength or speed.
She sets the pole's foot on the line and steps through.
The seam closes over her like water: a low black ceiling, and no way back.
Her eyes will not adjust; the only light is her own Open Eye icon.
The floor is ankle-deep pale grit, fine as cremation ash.
She counts the room by smell: dry mineral ash over a thick digesting reek.
The den is silent, like something holding its breath, and cold as a body on a table.
She understands she is the one warm thing in the room, burning like a lamp.
She stands still, pole low and crosswise, and waits to be found.
Ash pours off a great slow shape rising close, ahead and to her left.
It breathes in, and the den's whole air bends toward it.
Nimue swings at the inhale; the pole skates off a crust as hard as a kiln.
She strikes again and again; every blow scatters off the fused crust.
The creature exhales a cone of pulverized ash into her eyes, mouth and throat.
Blind and choking, she drops to her knees in the ash.
It surges in and bites; the jaw closes on the pole and her left forearm together.
The crusted jaw grinds her arm; she wrenches free and sprawls.
The System: Hostile contact. You are bleeding heat. It can taste where you are.
Four full blows did nothing and one bite has her losing, like a code started too late.
Aloud she tells herself: stop swinging. You don't win this with your hands.
She presses the bleeding arm to her ribs to hide its heat.
She remembers the System kept the eye, not the hands, and means to use it.
She stops looking at the monster and looks for the flaw instead.
It lunges, and as it draws breath to cough, Open Eye lights one point.
Low under the jaw the crust parts over a soft pale throat, swelling on the inhale.
The System: WEAK POINT, THE GORGE. The soft is only soft on the inhale.
She treats it as a code with one right moment: read the swell, hit on the inhale.
She drives the pole up into the lit point, and it goes in soft.
The creature whistles and reels back off the pole; hot fluid sheets over her hands.
Enraged, it rakes her ribs and coughs her blind again.
She has the rhythm now: bait the heat, let it commit, wait for the inhale.
As it rears to cough she spends her active and Reads it.
READ: the crust is a hollow shell; it cannot mend, and it cannot outlast her.
She understands it is a husk: all shell and one soft breath.
Open Eye shows the crust is fused human bone: knuckle, rib and skull.
It armored itself in the unascended dead, swept down to the Tower's root and eaten.
She recognizes her city in it: the bus-wheel man, the woman with the oranges.
Her hands don't shake; she sets the horror behind the engine for later.
She sets her feet, reads the swell, and puts everything into the Gorge on the inhale.
The eye finds the killing line inside the killing line, and she strikes there.
The creature sags into its own ash with a long exhale and goes still.
She has killed it in a handful of exchanges, because she saw.
Kneeling with the pole in the wound, she waits for her hands to shake; they don't.
Open Eye traces a fine blue-white thread through the dying creature, root to crust.
The thread converted the dead into bone-plate and bulk: neither biology nor magic, but System.
She understands the Tower grows its trials from the people it has culled.
The dead are inventory: the Tower keeps what you cannot.
Above her she feels a hundred floors, a hundred things grown from a hundred slaughters.
The System: FLOOR 1, TRIAL COMPLETE. The Ash-Glutton is slain. You ascend.
Subject note: cleared by precision, not attrition. Recorded.
The System turns to offering: HARVEST. Take one piece of the slain into yourself.
What you take is yours until you trade it away; this is the first never human.
Essence Slot 2 stands open. Option one is Ash-Hide, the crust as armor.
Option two is Unhinged Jaw, the bite that broke steel and bone.
Option three is Cinder-Cough, the cone of grave-ash that blinded her.
Option four, seen by her eye alone, is Carrion Bloom, the conversion-thread.
She feels what is asked: to make a monster a permanent tenant of her flesh.
Each harvest will trade more of her away, until she may not be a woman at all.
The fourth piece is a door her eye opened, offered to her and no one else.
To take a piece is to desecrate her city's dead, or to carry them onward.
She kneels at the carcass, hand not yet extended, and the four lights wait.
